sourceFile: 53. BRS-161014  Report test VP change mold press, Vulcanizing agent 10%, dry 120 and 150 date 29.7.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid source rows but unsafe grouping of the test matrix and outcomes.
issues: Changed factor conflates mold press, dry temperature, vulcanizing agent, and VP mold.
Baseline is unclear and normal VP row is not integrated correctly.
Merged-cell conditions are lost, making many VP mold-only rows incomplete.
Spurious measurement outcomes summarize headers and categorical values.
Decision rows are cited in context but not used to align final judgement.
requiredUserQuestions: Is normal-normal-normal VP mold #6 the baseline for function only or for all outcomes?
Should VP mold #4/#7/#8 be treated as test conditions or subgroup units?
correctionPlan: Rebuild one review case around the full validation matrix from rows 3, 7, 21-22, 49-50, and 77-86.
Preserve row keys: date, line, mold press, raw material, 2nd dry, and VP mold for every result row.
Separate or clearly nest factors for 90/120 Kgf, 120/150 C dry, and normal/+10% agent.
Keep only bending, vision/function NG rate outcomes; remove artificial measurement statistics.
Add judgement from decision rows: VP #4/#8 not usable, VP #7 condition-dependent.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient for final evidence until corrected.
